description: Plain decode with the load-time host-tier stripe FORCED ON (CAMELID_GEMMA4_GHOST_TIER_PREFILL=1). It is off by default -- auto requires the tier to cover 40% of all expert records and it covers 25% -- and this arm exists to keep the reason on file. The stripe fills experts 0..31 of every layer, an index-ordered set unrelated to routing, and prefill's 2,176 first-touch inserts displace it before decode asks anything: measured paired x3, the decode-phase tier hit rate is IDENTICAL with and without it (484 hits / 1,094 storage reads), while load costs 4.1 s more (12.1-13.1 s against 8.5-8.8 s). Pure cost.
